registryName: LIVE // EARTH Global Source & Rights Registry
policyPrinciples: Free-to-read is not automatically free-to-store, transform, publish or redistribute.
Text and image rights are evaluated independently for each story.
A story is publishable only with meaningful approved text, an independently verified relevant image, or both.
The most restrictive applicable item or source condition controls.
Unknown, missing or conflicting evidence fails closed.
Use approved educational/non-commercial permissions where the source actually grants them; educational purpose never overrides item-level or third-party restrictions.
All source permissions and restrictions live in this one central registry and are evaluated by the shared Global Checker for both views.

useContext.limitation: This purpose is context for applying source permissions, not an independent copyright licence or an override of source terms.

publicationEligibility.description: A story requires meaningful rights-approved text or an independently rights-approved relevant image with caption and attribution. Headline and link alone are never sufficient.

policies.displayName: Official NASA source material — conditional educational/informational use

text.reason: Official NASA-created U.S. government material may generally be used for educational/informational purposes with source acknowledgement. Third-party works, restrictive notices, NASA branding and endorsement remain excluded.

notes: NASA-created U.S. government content is generally not subject to U.S. copyright, but third-party copyrighted material may appear on NASA sites and is not cleared by NASA's own use.
NASA insignia, logotypes, identifiers, endorsement, promotional uses and individual likeness concerns remain separate restrictions.
If an item identifies a non-NASA author or exposes a restrictive rights signal, the Checker holds it rather than presuming public-domain status.
This single policy covers NASA sources in both Nature and Alien World; view-specific feed subscriptions remain in their respective profiles.

policies.displayName: NOAA National Ocean Service — agency-created educational material

text.reason: Official NOAA-created educational and informational material may be reused with credit. Third-party or restrictive item-level material is excluded.

notes: NOAA Ocean Service states that most information is public domain unless the credit or caption says otherwise; credit NOAA and follow any item-specific instructions.
Do not imply NOAA endorsement, claim NOAA material as original app content, or alter content and present the altered version as official NOAA material.

policies.displayName: USGS National News Releases — agency-created educational material

text.reason: USGS-authored and produced informational material is generally public domain with credit. Third-party works and item-level copyright notices remain excluded.

policies.displayName: Phys.org RSS — limited headline and link use

text.reason: Phys.org permits attributed RSS feed use with the supplied headline/link; source summaries are not retained or displayed. Under the app's content rule, headline-only items require a separately approved relevant image to publish.

policies.displayName: Mongabay — exact article licence and author required

text.reason: Mongabay story text is reusable only when the exact article publishes an accepted editable licence, a named author is identified, and all required attributions and links are preserved.

notes: Do not infer a Creative Commons licence from the Mongabay domain or RSS feed. The exact article page must disclose its licence and named author.
The common CC BY-ND republication route is held until all no-derivatives conditions, including unchanged text, attribution, embedded links and view-counter requirements, can be guaranteed.

Mongabay-labelled own photographs may be reusable for eligible educational/non-commercial websites only unchanged with label retained. Third-party photographs require separate permission; this pipeline does not automatically download Mongabay photos.

text.reason: ScienceDaily RSS terms prohibit placing retrieved or derived content in a database without prior written consent. The Collector uses persistent SQLite storage.

policies.displayName: Nature Portfolio — database population prohibited by site terms

text.reason: Nature Portfolio site terms prohibit copying/downloading/storing site content, feeds or data to populate a database or publication unless specifically permitted by applicable terms.

registryNotes: All active and restricted source policies are maintained in this one source-registry.json and evaluated by the shared Global Checker.
NOAA, NASA and USGS official feed routes are approved for eligible educational/informational reuse with agency credit, subject to item-level and third-party restrictions.
Phys.org RSS headlines/links may be retained with attribution; its summary is not stored. A headline-only item still needs an independently approved image to meet publication eligibility.
ScienceDaily and Nature Portfolio remain blocked for persistent database storage absent written permission or an item-specific permission route.
USDA ARS and EEA remain pending because direct official XML feed endpoints were not verified in this source review.
